Decision The Committee carried the recommendation unanimously. Background Business on Regent Street, Chippendale have requested a review of the parking restrictions on the eastern side of Regent Street, between Lee and Kensington Streets, ie outside Central Station Bus Terminal and the Mortuary Station, to improve parking availability, particularly in the evenings and on weekends for visitors/customers to the area. The City has reviewed parking operations on the eastern side of Regent Street and identified the need to update restrictions to better service the needs of the community and align with existing ticket parking restrictions on the western side of the street. Regent Street is under the authority of Roads & Maritime Services (RMS) and RMS has confirmed that they had no objection to the proposed parking changes.
